sections.title: MPA Professional Development & Career Seminar
sections.description: In these weekly sessions, MPA students will participate in workshops and informational sessions regarding key components of the career services program at Fels, including internships, job search strategy, professional networking, capstone projects etc. Enrollment is required for MPA students.
